theory.manualProofReview: Definition uses common length unit, nonzero denominator, fixed correspondence, and equal scale for each of three pairs. All unit-segment ratios verified.
Both angle equality and three side ratios are required by the definition. Direction k=3/2 and reciprocal2/3 are consistent. k=1 justified by SSS congruence.
Area ratio k² derived from earlier equal-angle area theorem58; no circular AA assumption.
Third angle from angle sum; equal-angle area comparisons yield all side ratios. Acute, right and obtuse exact cases included.
Auxiliary ABC₂ built from two angles on opposite side of AB; appears step2. AA gives AC₂=AC, SAS congruence gives second angle, then AA completes proof. Included angle condition explicit.
Auxiliary triangle first established by AA; equal side lengths follow from three ratios; SSS congruence and then SAS similarity complete proof without circular use of SSS similarity.

Midline proved through SAS similarity and converse angle criterion for parallel lines. Median proof has correct GAB↔GDE correspondence, ratio2:1 from vertex, and uniqueness along BE proves third-median concurrence.

Incenter/circumcenter equidistance arguments are self-contained. Outer parallel triangle has original vertices as side midpoints; original altitude lines are its perpendicular bisectors. Correct acute/right/obtuse orthocenter cases. Author added separately reachable auxiliary case7 after review request so final focus does not remove access to the construction.

All three ordered similarities independently verified. CD²=AD·DB; AC²=AB·AD; BC²=AB·BD use correct own projections. Positive geometric mean and interior foot conditions explicit. Unequal/equal projection cases verified.

Positive-angle and angle-sum existence requirements, positive prescribed bisector, construction on rays for enlargement or reduction, and congruence uniqueness are justified. Neutral scene has only given angles/segment; constructions reveal in order. Both1.6 and0.6 cases verified.

Horizontal ground, vertical objects and collinear sightline are explicitly required. Height5.1m correct. Scale1:1000 uses130m↔130mm. Independent tangent-ray intersection gives146.077717m for73°/58°, rejecting printed153m; discrepancy retained explicitly rather than altering source angles.
Correct adjacent/opposite catets for angleA, ratio definitions, independence via AA, positive denominator in tg=sin/cos, and Pythagorean identity. Actual printed181–182 inspected; no invented typo.
All nine30°/45°/60° values derived from equilateral construction and equal-leg right triangle, including rationalization and positive roots. Correct side/angle assignments independently checked.
